about.body: Mana Tenali is a local discovery and community app for Tenali, Andhra Pradesh. Find shops, food, offers, events and local news - with sources and update times shown so you know what to trust.

manage.ownerNote: You can update the description, contact details, hours and photos. Contact an admin to change the name, category or address.

admin.businessesHint: Create, verify, publish and archive listings

submit.addHint: List your shop or service on Mana Tenali

categoriesAdmin.title: Categories
categoriesAdmin.hint: Main categories and subcategories for businesses
categoriesAdmin.note: Categories are never deleted because businesses may use them. Deactivate one to hide it from new listings and filters.
categoriesAdmin.emptyBody: Run the seed script or add a main category.

food.menuNote: Prices are listed by the business and may change.

v.section: Give each menu section a name.

v.price: Enter a valid price for each item (in rupees).

f.title: Event name
f.whenHint: Use India time (IST). Events can run for up to 90 days.
f.businessHint: Pick the business hosting the event, if it is listed.

v.tooLong: An event can last at most 90 days.
v.bookingUrl: Use a full link starting with https://
v.location: Enter both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty.

evidence.title: Proof for verification
evidence.hint: Add 1 to {{max}} files: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB, PDF up to 10 MB (20 pages).
evidence.privacyNote: Only you and the Mana Tenali team can see these files - they are never shown publicly. Please don’t upload Aadhaar or other ID cards.
evidence.keepOne: At least one file is required. Add the new file before removing the last one.
evidence.adminNote: Private evidence. Links are created on demand and expire after 5 minutes. PDFs download only.

v.type: Only JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF files are allowed.

v.pdfSize: PDF files can be at most 10 MB.

v.wait: Please wait until all files have finished uploading.
v.required: Add at least one proof file.
